pain_point: Commute and location concerns - I need something close to the freeway and port — Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?
headline_pain: Still Renting Closer to the City?
primary_text: "Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?" Ask the hundreds of businesses that relocated there in the last 3 years. They're paying less, moving freight faster, and own their premises outright. The West Gate Tunnel has changed the game — Truganina to the CBD is now quicker than many inner-east commutes. You could keep renting a cramped unit in Footscray for twice the cost, or you could own a brand-new warehouse with office space in Melbourne's industrial growth zone. Smart operators are moving west. Don't be the last one paying rent.
description: Hundreds of businesses have already relocated to Truganina's industrial precinct
